storm-spellslinger: Close to fair share: 24.6% of games and 17.7% of series.

reanimator-graveyard: Good: 29.0% of games and 21.7% of series.

aristocrats: Weak: 16.8% of games and 8.3% of series.

counters: Fair share: 26.7% of games and 18.0% of series.

aggro-combat: Slightly below fair: 23.1% of games and 15.3% of series. You're knocked out first in 49% of games.

burn-group-slug: Below fair: 21.5% of games and 14.0% of series.
